$comment: Planet descriptions and how to use each planet's lucky set. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.planet.sun: The Sun (1) stands for the self, vitality, authority and confidence. Its day is Sunday.
blocks.planet.moon: The Moon (2) stands for the mind, feelings, care and imagination. Its day is Monday.
blocks.planet.jupiter: Jupiter (3) stands for wisdom, growth, teachers and good fortune. Its day is Thursday.
blocks.planet.rahu: Rahu (4) stands for ambition, change and the unconventional. In this system it is read through Saturn, and its day is Saturday.
blocks.planet.mercury: Mercury (5) stands for intelligence, speech, trade and adaptability. Its day is Wednesday.
blocks.planet.venus: Venus (6) stands for love, beauty, comfort and the arts. Its day is Friday.
blocks.planet.ketu: Ketu (7) stands for insight, detachment and the spiritual. In this system it is read through Mars, and its day is Tuesday.
blocks.planet.saturn: Saturn (8) stands for discipline, time, justice and endurance. Its day is Saturday.
blocks.planet.mars: Mars (9) stands for energy, courage, action and protection. Its day is Tuesday.
blocks.lucky.planet.sun: With the Sun leading, use the lucky numbers and Sunday for beginnings, interviews and anything that needs confidence. Gold and orange support it.
blocks.lucky.planet.moon: With the Moon leading, use the lucky numbers and Monday for relationships, family matters and creative work. White and cream support it.
blocks.lucky.planet.jupiter: With Jupiter leading, use the lucky numbers and Thursday for study, advice, finance and important agreements. Yellow supports it.
blocks.lucky.planet.rahu: With Rahu leading, use the lucky numbers and Saturday for planning, technology and steady practical work. Grey and blue support it.
blocks.lucky.planet.mercury: With Mercury leading, use the lucky numbers and Wednesday for business, travel, writing and negotiation. Green supports it.
blocks.lucky.planet.venus: With Venus leading, use the lucky numbers and Friday for celebrations, creative work and buying things for the home. White, pink and light blue support it.
blocks.lucky.planet.ketu: With Ketu leading, use the lucky numbers and Tuesday for research, reflection and spiritual practice. Smoky grey supports it.
blocks.lucky.planet.saturn: With Saturn leading, use the lucky numbers and Saturday for long-term plans, property and steady commitments. Black and dark blue support it.
blocks.lucky.planet.mars: With Mars leading, use the lucky numbers and Tuesday for bold steps, sport and starting physical work. Red supports it.
